description:
Adele who became a new hunter on behalf of her sick uncle!  
First day of battle! Kidnapped by a human-eating wolf, Carl!

No, but this human-eating wolf is a little weird?!  
Isn't he a human-eating wolf?

He's the only one who comes down as a legend.  
An ancient wolf who could use magic!  
And also their prince?

But why do I have to be your pet?!  
As a human being with dignity.  
I'm just with you as a little bit of good faith?

Against Tristan, a "dark wolf" who's driving the world into darkness  
The wolf who tries to save the world, the sword, and how he became his pet  
Adele's world of cutie fantasy romance!

Can they save the world?  
And will Adele be able to escape Carl's pet status? (Papago)
